reasons.claim: 0.93 ha regeneration felling notification, status notified; no completed felling overlaps the polygon (0%).

One eligible species is within 250 m: Goodyera repens (VU, forest-associated, site-bound vascular plant). Its threats include lack of dead wood and increased openness in tree-covered land. There are 3 records, all 2025, at 210-248 m with 5 m uncertainty.
One NT site-bound forest fungus, Porodaedalea pini, lies at 234 m (2025). The NT bird Poecile montanus (mobile) lies at 233 m. Both are supporting evidence only.

Effort is below the county median (89 records within 1000 m vs median 149, 33rd percentile). Near-site, 7 records from 4 species over 2 days lie within 250 m, and there are none inside the polygon. Because a threatened site-bound species was recorded nearby, the rubric still gives HIGH.

uncertainties: The eligible records lie at 210-248 m, near the edge of the 250 m ring, and none are inside the polygon.
Effort is below the county median and near-site recording covers only 2 days, so the picture of what is present is thin.
Records are from 2025 and may predate the notification.
not_established: That Goodyera repens or any other red-listed species occupies the felling polygon.
No records inside the polygon does not show absence of species.
next_action: Have an ecologist review the stand for habitat of Goodyera repens, using the 2025 GBIF records at 210-248 m, and consider a field visit because recording effort is low.
